options.text: When all light passes through a boundary without any reflection
When light hits a boundary at an angle greater than the critical angle and is completely reflected back
When light is absorbed completely by a medium
When light reflects from a mirror with 100% efficiency

questions.explanation: Total internal reflection occurs when light travelling in a denser medium hits the boundary at an angle greater than the critical angle. All the light is reflected back into the denser medium, with none passing through the boundary.

questions.stem: When a wave is refracted, which property remains unchanged?
questions.explanation: When a wave is refracted, the frequency remains unchanged because it is determined by the source. The speed and wavelength both change as the wave enters the new medium.
